description: List the distinct values seen for a usage dimension ("metric" or "external_customer_id") over a date range — useful for discovering filter values before calling query_usage. Each entry pairs the raw `value` with a `label` (for external_customer_id, the customer's name from account_customers when known, falling back to the id itself). Mirrors GET /api/usage/dimensions.

dimension.description: "metric", "external_customer_id", "dimension_key" (the keys of the pushed dimensions map) or "dimension:<key>" (that key's values)

name: list_usage_dimensions
